title: Manipal University Jaipur Celebrates Karnataka Rajyotsava with Karnataka Sangha
summary: Manipal University Jaipur and Karnataka Sangha, Jaipur, marked Karnataka Rajyotsava on campus with folk music, dance and cultural performances by students and the Kannadiga community.
body_html:
Jaipur, 17 November 2026: Manipal University Jaipur (MUJ), in association with Karnataka Sangha, Jaipur, celebrated Karnataka Rajyotsava at its campus on 15 November 2026. The celebration brought together members of the Kannadiga community living in Jaipur and the university fraternity to mark the cultural heritage, language, artistic traditions and values of Karnataka.

The event was attended by Cdr. (Dr.) Anil Rana, Pro-President, Manipal University Jaipur. Founding members and office bearers of Karnataka Sangha, Jaipur, members of the Kannadiga community and their families, university leadership, faculty members, staff and students also took part.

Addressing the gathering, Cdr. (Dr.) Anil Rana spoke about the importance of staying rooted in one's cultural heritage while actively contributing to nation-building and enriching the country's diverse cultural fabric.

The programme opened with an inaugural session, followed by a cultural programme dedicated to Karnataka's heritage and traditions. The organisers said the gathering reflected a shared commitment by the university and Karnataka Sangha to preserving and promoting the Kannada language, cultural values and traditional art forms, especially among Kannadigas living away from their home state.

The main attraction of the day was a series of cultural performances. Children, students of Manipal University Jaipur and members of the Kannadiga community from different parts of Jaipur presented traditional folk performances, music, dance and other cultural items, giving the audience a glimpse of Karnataka's varied cultural landscape and the talents of participants across generations.

The participation of children and young students was seen as especially significant, as it introduced the younger generation to their mother tongue, cultural roots and traditional values. The event also gave the Kannadiga community an opportunity to share its heritage with the wider university community and the multicultural population of Jaipur.

Beyond the performances, the celebration served as a platform for strengthening community bonds and a sense of belonging among Kannadigas living outside Karnataka. Through the joint initiative, the university reiterated its commitment to cultural diversity, inclusiveness and community engagement. The celebration concluded on a note of cultural pride and togetherness, reflecting the spirit of unity in diversity.
